We totally get that long delays are frustrating. In general, compensation/refunds come from two angles:

Courier delay: If you paid for a guaranteed/next‑day postal service that wasn’t fulfilled, you may be able to claim a refund directly from the courier, not from us.
Rental arriving late: If your rental item arrives after the first rental day and you report it and return it within 24 hours of delivery, you’re usually entitled to a full refund of the rental. If you return it later than 24 hours, you may receive only a partial refund, based on how many rental days were effectively lost.

So yes, there can be compensation for long delays, but it depends on whether it’s a shipping service failure (handled by the courier) or a late rental arrival (handled via our refund rules).
